name: Solar Philippines Tarlac Solar Farm
info: The largest solar power farm in Southeast Asia, producing up to 150 MW of electricity and powering around 150,000 homes.

name: Mindanao Solar Power Project
info: A 20 MW solar energy project developed to increase renewable energy capacity in Mindanao and reduce reliance on coal.

name: North Luzon Renewable Energy Corporation (NLREC) Wind Farm
info: A 150 MW wind power project utilizing strong wind currents in Ilocos Norte, providing sustainable energy to the Luzon grid.

name: Burgos Wind Farm
info: Operated by EDC, this wind farm generates 150 MW and is one of the largest wind power facilities in Southeast Asia.

name: Bakun Hydro Power Plant
info: A 70 MW hydropower plant that utilizes mountain river flows to contribute to renewable energy in the Cordillera region.

name: San Carlos BioPower
address: 888 Biomass Blvd, San Carlos, Negros Occidental
info: A 20 MW biomass power plant generating electricity using sugarcane waste, supporting sustainable energy production.

name: Nasulo Geothermal Power Plant
info: Produces 49.4 MW of geothermal energy, tapping into natural geothermal resources to provide clean energy to Negros Island.
